cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've crossed my name on the night rota like you. Put yours back if this shelter matters to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My cross cancels my shift. You just cancelled yours too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, clearing space to supervise. You take midnight to four and I'll stay available.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll do it if you sit at the desk beside me. We can split the calls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could we split them before midnight? I need to be asleep by eleven to supervise properly.

reason: Ground the copied confidence in a specific misunderstood act and make it alter the exact Drive pursuit, with a final response based on B4 rather than an abstract mechanism summary.
